scope.description: Competitors to the Katapull Commerce Hub as a whole: vendors that win shared customers by covering several links of the chain (shop, marketplaces, POS, ERP, EDI, warehouse, shipping, returns) with one product or one ecosystem, so the customer needs fewer Katapull platforms.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: players profiled in at least one Katapull platform productscape that overlap two or more Katapull platforms for the same shared customer persona (suite, stack or app-ecosystem competitors), plus ChannelEngine as a best-of-breed benchmark for the EffectConnect link. Excluded: single-category specialists that compete with only one platform. They stay in that platform's own landscape, for example Channable, Returnless, SPS Commerce, MplusKASSA and GoedGepickt.
scope.notes: Business stats and links are copied unchanged from the sibling competition files, which hold the original sources. The role (direct, substitute or benchmark) and the overlap with Katapull platforms are this productscape's own analysis. Where sibling files disagreed, the more recent figure was kept: Lightspeed FY2026 revenue and Odoo 2026 company figures.

players.name: Shopify
players.categoryRelevance: Overlaps Highbiza · Vendit · Logic4 (host platform for EffectConnect, DeliveryMatch, Picqer, Returnista)
players.description: Global commerce platform with webshop, B2B and POS. It competes for the selling layer and the system of record: Highbiza compares itself against Shopify, Vendit competes with Shopify POS, and Logic4 loses traders who prefer Shopify plus connectors over all-in-one. For the fulfilment side of the hub it is a host platform, not a competitor. DeliveryMatch (Shopify app since 2019), Returnista (Shopify app since 2023), Picqer (own Shopify connector) and EffectConnect (Shopify plugin) all sell into Shopify stores, so a Shopify merchant can still be a four-platform Katapull customer (persona `shpm`). Shopify's own shipping and marketplace features are not assessed here because the platform productscapes do not source them. Also profiled in: `b2b-wholesale-ecommerce-platform`, `omnichannel-commerce-erp-platform`, `retail-pos-and-store-management-platform`.
